SELECT u.id, u.username, u.phone, u.password, u.trade_password, u.parent_id, u.avatar, u.ancestors, u.sex, u.email, u.credit_score, u.balance, u.frozen_balance, IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(pending_withdrawal.amount) FROM order_withdrawal pending_withdrawal WHERE pending_withdrawal.user_id = u.id AND pending_withdrawal.status = '1' ), 0) AS withdraw_frozen_amount, (u.balance + u.frozen_balance) AS total_balance, u.invite_code, u.register_ip, u.last_login_time, u.account_status, u.trade_status, u.withdraw_status, u.real_name_status, u.real_name, u.id_card_number, u.id_card_front, u.id_card_back, u.withdraw_name, u.withdraw_address, u.withdraw_type, u.create_time, u.remark, u.is_real, u.level_id, u.commission, u.all_commission, u.deal_count, u.card_number, u.card_amount, u.task_status, u.version,
( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_withdrawal w WHERE w.user_id = u.id AND w.application_time >= CURDATE() AND w.application_time < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY ) AS today_withdraw_count,
u.total_withdraw_count, u.today_reset_count, u.total_reset_count, u.withdraw_tip,
-- 父级信息 parent_user.username AS parent_username, parent_user.phone AS parent_phone,
-- 直属下级数量 (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_member_user d WHERE d.parent_id = u.id) AS direct_sub_count,
-- 所有下级数量（使用 FIND_IN_SET 替代 LIKE） (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_member_user a WHERE FIND_IN_SET(u.id, a.ancestors)) AS all_sub_count,
-- 等级信息 l.id AS levelId, l.icon, l.name_zh, l.name_en, l.price, l.auto_upgrade_invite_count, l.commission_ratio, l.streak_commission_ratio, l.min_balance, l.order_count, l.withdraw_count, l.withdraw_limit, l.min_withdraw_amount, l.max_withdraw_amount, l.withdraw_fee, l.withdraw_order_per_day, l.description_zh, l.description_en, l.create_time AS levelTime,
-- 使用当前余额作为累计充值金额 IFNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = '0' THEN IFNULL(t.amout, 0) ELSE IFNULL(t.real_money, 0) END) FROM order_topup t WHERE t.user_id = u.id AND t.status = '0'), 0) AS total_recharge, IFNULL((SELECT SUM(w.credited_amount) FROM order_withdrawal w WHERE w.user_id = u.id AND w.status = '0'), 0) AS total_withdraw, ( IFNULL((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = '0' THEN IFNULL(t.amout, 0) ELSE IFNULL(t.real_money, 0) END) FROM order_topup t WHERE t.user_id = u.id AND t.status = '0'), 0) - IFNULL((SELECT SUM(w.credited_amount) FROM order_withdrawal w WHERE w.user_id = u.id AND w.status = '0'), 0) ) AS diff_amount, -- 最大可达等级价格（小于等于当前余额） (SELECT MAX(l2.price) FROM order_member_level l2 WHERE l2.price <= u.balance ) AS max_level_price,
-- 下一等级价格（大于最大可达等级的最小价格，如果无最大等级则取最小价格） (SELECT MIN(l2.price) FROM order_member_level l2 WHERE l2.price > COALESCE( (SELECT MAX(l3.price) FROM order_member_level l3 WHERE l3.price <= u.balance ), -1 -- 使用一个负值作为占位符，确保 > -1 总是取 MIN(price) )) AS next_level_price,
-- 计算距离下一等级所需的充值金额 COALESCE( ( SELECT MIN(l2.price) FROM order_member_level l2 WHERE l2.price > COALESCE( (SELECT MAX(l3.price) FROM order_member_level l3 WHERE l3.price <= u.balance ), -1 ) ) - u.balance, 0 ) AS recharge_needed_for_next_level
FROM order_member_user u LEFT JOIN order_member_level l ON u.level_id = l.id LEFT JOIN order_member_user parent_user ON u.parent_id = parent_user.id

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.phone, u.password, u.trade_password, u.parent_id, u.avatar, u.ancestors, u.sex, u.email, u.credit_score, u.balance, u.frozen_balance, (u.balance + u.frozen_balance) AS total_balance, u.invite_code, u.register_ip, u.last_login_time, u.account_status, u.trade_status, u.withdraw_status, u.real_name_status, u.real_name, u.id_card_number, u.id_card_front, u.id_card_back, u.withdraw_name, u.withdraw_address, u.withdraw_type, u.create_time, u.remark, u.is_real, u.level_id, u.commission, u.all_commission, u.deal_count, u.card_number, u.card_amount, u.task_status, u.version, u.total_withdraw_count, u.today_reset_count, u.total_reset_count, u.withdraw_tip, parent_user.username AS parent_username, parent_user.phone AS parent_phone, l.id AS levelId, l.icon, l.name_zh, l.name_en, l.price, l.auto_upgrade_invite_count, l.commission_ratio, l.streak_commission_ratio, l.min_balance, l.order_count, l.withdraw_count, l.withdraw_limit, l.min_withdraw_amount, l.max_withdraw_amount, l.withdraw_fee, l.withdraw_order_per_day, l.description_zh, l.description_en, l.create_time AS levelTime, COALESCE( ( SELECT MIN(next_level.price) FROM order_member_level next_level WHERE next_level.price > COALESCE( ( SELECT MAX(current_level.price) FROM order_member_level current_level WHERE current_level.price <= u.balance ), -1 ) ) - u.balance, 0 ) AS recharge_needed_for_next_level FROM order_member_user u LEFT JOIN order_member_level l ON u.level_id = l.id LEFT JOIN order_member_user parent_user ON u.parent_id = parent_user.id
mapper.select: order by u.create_time desc
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_member_user u

WHERE u.id IN

WITH candidate AS ( SELECT u.id FROM order_member_user u
)
SELECT candidate.id FROM candidate LEFT JOIN ( SELECT topup.user_id, SUM( CASE WHEN topup.type = '0' THEN IFNULL(topup.amout, 0) ELSE IFNULL(topup.real_money, 0) END ) AS total_recharge FROM order_topup topup INNER JOIN candidate matched_candidate ON matched_candidate.id = topup.user_id WHERE topup.status = '0' GROUP BY topup.user_id ) aggregate_sort ON aggregate_sort.user_id = candidate.id ORDER BY COALESCE(aggregate_sort.total_recharge, 0)
SELECT candidate.id FROM candidate LEFT JOIN ( SELECT withdrawal.user_id, SUM( CASE WHEN withdrawal.status = '0' THEN IFNULL(withdrawal.credited_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END ) AS total_withdraw, SUM( CASE WHEN withdrawal.status = '1' THEN IFNULL(withdrawal.amount, 0) ELSE 0 END ) AS withdraw_frozen_amount, SUM( CASE WHEN withdrawal.application_time >= CURDATE() AND withdrawal.application_time < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS today_withdraw_count FROM order_withdrawal withdrawal INNER JOIN candidate matched_candidate ON matched_candidate.id = withdrawal.user_id GROUP BY withdrawal.user_id ) aggregate_sort ON aggregate_sort.user_id = candidate.id ORDER BY
COALESCE(aggregate_sort.total_withdraw, 0)
COALESCE(aggregate_sort.withdraw_frozen_amount, 0)
COALESCE(aggregate_sort.today_withdraw_count, 0)
SELECT candidate.id FROM candidate LEFT JOIN ( SELECT topup.user_id, SUM( CASE WHEN topup.type = '0' THEN IFNULL(topup.amout, 0) ELSE IFNULL(topup.real_money, 0) END ) AS total_recharge FROM order_topup topup INNER JOIN candidate matched_candidate ON matched_candidate.id = topup.user_id WHERE topup.status = '0' GROUP BY topup.user_id ) topup_sort ON topup_sort.user_id = candidate.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT withdrawal.user_id, SUM(IFNULL(withdrawal.credited_amount, 0)) AS total_withdraw FROM order_withdrawal withdrawal INNER JOIN candidate matched_candidate ON matched_candidate.id = withdrawal.user_id WHERE withdrawal.status = '0' GROUP BY withdrawal.user_id ) withdrawal_sort ON withdrawal_sort.user_id = candidate.id ORDER BY COALESCE(topup_sort.total_recharge, 0) - COALESCE(withdrawal_sort.total_withdraw, 0)
SELECT candidate.id FROM candidate LEFT JOIN ( SELECT direct_user.parent_id AS user_id, COUNT(*) AS direct_sub_count FROM order_member_user direct_user INNER JOIN candidate matched_candidate ON matched_candidate.id = direct_user.parent_id GROUP BY direct_user.parent_id ) aggregate_sort ON aggregate_sort.user_id = candidate.id ORDER BY COALESCE(aggregate_sort.direct_sub_count, 0)
SELECT candidate.id FROM candidate LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ancestor_token.ancestor_id, COUNT(DISTINCT descendant.id) AS all_sub_count FROM order_member_user descendant INNER JOIN JSON_TABLE( CONCAT( '[', REPLACE( JSON_QUOTE(IFNULL(descendant.ancestors, '')), ',', '","' ), ']' ), '$[*]' COLUMNS (ancestor_id VARCHAR(32) PATH '$') ) ancestor_token GROUP BY ancestor_token.ancestor_id ) aggregate_sort ON aggregate_sort.ancestor_id = CAST(candidate.id AS CHAR) ORDER BY COALESCE(aggregate_sort.all_sub_count, 0)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_member_user u

SELECT financial.user_id, SUM(financial.total_recharge) AS total_recharge, SUM(financial.total_withdraw) AS total_withdraw, SUM(financial.withdraw_frozen_amount) AS withdraw_frozen_amount, SUM(financial.today_withdraw_count) AS today_withdraw_count FROM ( SELECT topup.user_id, SUM( CASE WHEN topup.type = '0' THEN IFNULL(topup.amout, 0) ELSE IFNULL(topup.real_money, 0) END ) AS total_recharge, 0 AS total_withdraw, 0 AS withdraw_frozen_amount, 0 AS today_withdraw_count FROM order_topup topup WHERE topup.status = '0' AND topup.user_id IN
#{userId}
GROUP BY topup.user_id
UNION ALL
SELECT withdrawal.user_id, 0 AS total_recharge, SUM( CASE WHEN withdrawal.status = '0' THEN IFNULL(withdrawal.credited_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END ) AS total_withdraw, SUM( CASE WHEN withdrawal.status = '1' THEN IFNULL(withdrawal.amount, 0) ELSE 0 END ) AS withdraw_frozen_amount, SUM( CASE WHEN withdrawal.application_time >= CURDATE() AND withdrawal.application_time < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS today_withdraw_count FROM order_withdrawal withdrawal WHERE withdrawal.user_id IN
#{userId}
GROUP BY withdrawal.user_id ) financial GROUP BY financial.user_id

SELECT subordinate.user_id, SUM(subordinate.direct_sub_count) AS direct_sub_count, SUM(subordinate.all_sub_count) AS all_sub_count FROM ( SELECT direct_user.parent_id AS user_id, COUNT(*) AS direct_sub_count, 0 AS all_sub_count FROM order_member_user direct_user WHERE direct_user.parent_id IN
#{userId}
GROUP BY direct_user.parent_id
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST(ancestor_token.ancestor_id AS UNSIGNED) AS user_id, 0 AS direct_sub_count, COUNT(DISTINCT descendant.id) AS all_sub_count FROM order_member_user descendant INNER JOIN JSON_TABLE( CONCAT( '[', REPLACE( JSON_QUOTE(IFNULL(descendant.ancestors, '')), ',', '","' ), ']' ), '$[*]' COLUMNS (ancestor_id VARCHAR(32) PATH '$') ) ancestor_token WHERE ancestor_token.ancestor_id IN
CAST(#{userId} AS CHAR)
GROUP BY ancestor_token.ancestor_id ) subordinate GROUP BY subordinate.user_id

mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE descendants AS ( SELECT u.id, u.parent_id, 0 AS depth FROM order_member_user u WHERE u.username = #{username} UNION ALL SELECT child.id, child.parent_id, parent.depth + 1 AS depth FROM order_member_user child INNER JOIN descendants parent ON child.parent_id = parent.id ), hierarchy AS ( SELECT d.depth, u.id AS user_id, u.create_time, IFNULL(u.balance, 0) AS balance, IFNULL(u.frozen_balance, 0) AS frozen_balance FROM descendants d JOIN order_member_user u ON u.id = d.id WHERE d.depth > 0 ), order_stats AS ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, IFNULL(SUM(price), 0) AS order_amount FROM order_info WHERE order_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY user_id ), topup_stats AS ( SELECT user_id, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN type = '0' THEN IFNULL(amout, 0) ELSE IFNULL(real_money, 0) END), 0) AS recharge_amount FROM order_topup WHERE status = '0' AND create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY user_id ), first_topup AS ( SELECT user_id, MIN(create_time) AS first_time FROM order_topup WHERE status = '0' GROUP BY user_id ), withdraw_stats AS ( SELECT user_id, IFNULL(SUM(credited_amount), 0) AS withdraw_amount, COUNT(*) AS withdraw_times FROM order_withdrawal WHERE status = '0' AND application_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY user_id ) SELECT h.depth AS level_depth, COUNT(*) AS total_members, SUM(CASE WHEN h.create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS new_register_count, SUM(CASE WHEN os.order_count IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS order_user_count, IFNULL(SUM(os.order_amount), 0) AS order_amount, IFNULL(SUM(h.balance + h.frozen_balance), 0) AS total_balance, SUM(CASE WHEN ft.first_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_deposit_count, IFNULL(SUM(ts.recharge_amount), 0) AS recharge_amount, IFNULL(SUM(ws.withdraw_amount), 0) AS withdraw_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN ws.withdraw_times IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS withdraw_user_count FROM hierarchy h LEFT JOIN order_stats os ON os.user_id = h.user_id LEFT JOIN topup_stats ts ON ts.user_id = h.user_id LEFT JOIN first_topup ft ON ft.user_id = h.user_id LEFT JOIN withdraw_stats ws ON ws.user_id = h.user_id GROUP BY h.depth ORDER BY h.depth

WITH RECURSIVE descendants AS ( SELECT u.id, u.parent_id, 0 AS depth FROM order_member_user u WHERE u.username = #{username} UNION ALL SELECT c.id, c.parent_id, p.depth + 1 FROM order_member_user c JOIN descendants p ON c.parent_id = p.id ) SELECT root.id AS user_id, root.username AS username, root.invite_code AS invite_code, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ac.create_time >= CURDATE() AND ac.create_time < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY THEN ac.change_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rebate_today, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ac.create_time >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND ac.create_time < CURDATE() THEN ac.change_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rebate_yesterday, IFNULL(SUM(ac.change_amount), 0) AS rebate_total, (COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) - 1) AS subordinates_count, COUNT(DISTINCT oi_all.user_id) AS total_trading_users, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN oi_today.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN oi_today.user_id END) AS today_trading_users, IFNULL((SELECT SUM(balance + frozen_balance) FROM order_member_user WHERE FIND_IN_SET(root.id, ancestors)), 0) AS total_subordinate_balance FROM descendants d JOIN order_member_user root ON root.username = #{username} LEFT JOIN order_account_change ac ON ac.user_id = d.id AND ac.`type` = '6' LEFT JOIN order_info oi_all ON oi_all.user_id = d.id LEFT JOIN order_info oi_today ON oi_today.user_id = d.id AND oi_today.order_time >= CURDATE() AND oi_today.order_time < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY root.id, root.username, root.invite_code

-- 返回指定用户名的第1、2、3层下级用户，每个用户包含用户名、层级、充值总额和提现总额 WITH RECURSIVE descendants AS ( SELECT u.id, u.parent_id, 0 AS depth FROM order_member_user u WHERE u.username = #{username} UNION ALL SELECT c.id, c.parent_id, p.depth + 1 FROM order_member_user c JOIN descendants p ON c.parent_id = p.id WHERE p.depth < 3 ) SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, d.depth AS level, u.create_time AS create_time, IFNULL(t.recharge_amount, 0) AS recharge_amount, IFNULL(w.withdraw_amount, 0) AS withdraw_amount FROM descendants d JOIN order_member_user u ON u.id = d.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, SUM(CASE WHEN type = '0' THEN IFNULL(amout, 0) ELSE IFNULL(real_money, 0) END) AS recharge_amount FROM order_topup WHERE status = '0' GROUP BY user_id ) t ON t.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, SUM(credited_amount) AS withdraw_amount FROM order_withdrawal WHERE status = '0' GROUP BY user_id ) w ON w.user_id = u.id WHERE d.depth BETWEEN 1 AND 3 ORDER BY d.depth ASC, u.username ASC
